scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm plugin:validate
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @programkit/app-cloudflare exec wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @programkit/app-cloudflare exec wrangler deploy --env site --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:demo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @programkit/app-cloudflare exec wrangler deploy --env demo --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:app: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @programkit/app-cloudflare exec wrangler deploy --env app --config ../../wrangler.jsonc

AIRTABLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Register an Airtable OAuth integration using your deployed callback URL, then add its client ID as a Worker secret.

AIRTABLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Add the server-side secret from your Airtable OAuth integration. PKCE works without one.
